# swc-plugin-react-data-testid

> An SWC (Rust/Wasm) compiler plugin that injects a unique `data-testid` attribute onto
> every React JSX element at build time, so end-to-end and component tests get stable
> selectors without anyone hand-writing them. Ids are deterministic and derivable from the
> source file alone: `ComponentName.element`, `ComponentName.element2`, and
> `{"ComponentName.li-" + index}` for elements rendered inside `.map()` callbacks.

Use this plugin when a React codebase compiled by SWC (Next.js, Vite via
`@vitejs/plugin-react-swc`, `@swc/jest`, `@swc/core`, Rspack) needs test selectors on
every element and you do not want to add them by hand or rely on text/role queries.
The attribute name is configurable, so it equally serves `data-cy` (Cypress),
`data-test-id` (Playwright), or several attributes at once.

It does not apply to Babel-compiled projects: SWC Wasm plugins run inside SWC only.

- Install: `npm install --save-dev swc-plugin-react-data-testid`
- Enable (`.swcrc`): `{"jsc":{"experimental":{"plugins":[["swc-plugin-react-data-testid",{}]]}}}`
- Enable (`next.config.js`): `experimental: { swcPlugins: [["swc-plugin-react-data-testid", {}]] }`
- No options are required to get unique ids; every inference option exists to turn one
  *off*. The single exception is `instanceIds`, which is off by default and prefixes a
  component's ids with the one its parent passed down, so two instances of the same
  component stop repeating ids.

## Docs

- [Agent reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator/master/AGENTS.md): the complete, precise specification of the naming algorithm — read this to predict generated ids, write selectors, or answer questions about the plugin's output. Also shipped inside the npm package as `AGENTS.md`.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator/master/readme.md): installation, per-framework setup (Next.js, Vite, Jest, Vitest, Rspack), worked transformations, limitations, example apps.
- [Options JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator/master/schema/plugin-options.schema.json): machine-readable definition of every plugin option, its type, default, and constraints.
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator/master/CHANGELOG.md): behavioural changes by version; 0.2.0 changed ids inside `.map()` callbacks, and 0.3.0 changed them again for the three iteration forms that still shared one id (`R.map(fn, items)`, `items.map(renderItem)`, a destructured index slot).

## Optional

- [This file on unpkg](https://unpkg.com/swc-plugin-react-data-testid/llms.txt): the docs ship inside the npm tarball, so `unpkg.com/swc-plugin-react-data-testid/{llms.txt,AGENTS.md,schema/plugin-options.schema.json}` serves each one at a stable URL without cloning the repo. `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swc-plugin-react-data-testid/…` serves the same paths.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/swc-plugin-react-data-testid): published versions and install stats.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator): source (`src/lib.rs`), fixture tests, runnable examples under `example/`.
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oakblu/plugin-react-data-testid-generator/master/CLAUDE.md): repo invariants and build rules — only relevant when modifying the plugin itself, not when using it.
